title: Define recovery requirements and expected metadata
goal: State what must be recovered before making a backup.
challenge: Using the supplied two-file fixture, retain an independent recovery inventory: exact names, bytes, modes, owner/group and timestamps. Define acceptable recovery time and data-loss assumptions; no repair command is supplied.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-backup-1; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Guard a fresh, learner-owned workspace and check guest free space. Stop if any command fails.
steps.expected: Private practice directory; at least 65536 KiB available.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-backup-1 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-backup-1 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && test -z "$(find . -type l -print -quit)"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define and use a location/owner guard for every later change.
steps.expected: Exact physical path, not a link.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0700 source && printf 'alpha\n' > source/note.txt && printf 'bravo\n' > 'source/space name.txt' && chmod 0640 source/note.txt && chmod 0600 'source/space name.txt' && touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Create two known regular files, including a name with a space.
steps.expected: alpha and bravo lines, modes640/600, fixed UTC timestamp.

steps.command: guard && printf '%s\n' 'Files: note.txt and space name.txt' 'Bytes: alpha and bravo, each ending in newline' 'Modes: 640 and 600; owner/group learner' 'mtime: 2026-01-01 UTC; recover within this practice session' 'RPO: this fixture snapshot; RTO: inspect and restore manually' > requirements.txt
steps.explanation: Requirements precede the backup. RPO is acceptable data loss; RTO is time to recovery.

steps.command: guard && (cd source && sha256sum -- note.txt 'space name.txt') > expected.sha256 && stat -c '%n %U:%G %a %Y %s' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt' > expected.metadata && cat requirements.txt expected.metadata
steps.explanation: Keep references outside the source/backup; later protect them separately.
steps.expected: Two known hashes; modes640/600 and matching fixed mtime.

hints: Inventory names as well as file bytes.
A checksum alone does not capture owner or mode.
A locally editable reference is not proof of authenticity.
review: Exact inventory, two hashes, expected metadata and RPO/RTO assumptions.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 206.2 partial manual archives/recovery; 104.5 reinforcement where applicable. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
